audit.scope: Per-net wire-capacitance conservation only; each net includes its own coupling entries when explicitly enabled. Aggregate sums are not unique physical capacitance. Excludes RC accuracy, connectivity, coupling symmetry/model correctness, timing and manufacturing acceptance.
